feat(json-patch): apply RFC 6902 JSON Patches

Add `applyPatch(document, patch)` with the six operations of RFC 6902 —
add, remove, replace, move, copy and test. The patch is applied to a deep
copy of the document, so neither argument is modified, the result shares
nothing with them, and a failing operation leaves nothing behind.

Split the JSON data model out into `src/json-value.ts`, under both
standards, and share the pointer module's array-index rule and token walk
with the operations that write through a pointer.

See dl-003, dl-004 and dl-005.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
